_comment: FakeGuard keyword library — single source of truth for all scoring rules. Edit this file to update keywords and weights without touching analyzer code.

suspicious_keywords._comment: Matched as whole words (case-insensitive). Only distinct keywords are counted — repeated occurrences of the same word count as one.

clickbait_phrases._comment: Matched as substrings (case-insensitive). Each distinct phrase found contributes points up to the category cap.
phrases: they don't want you to know

excessive_capitalization._comment: Fires when the ratio of uppercase letters to total letters exceeds the threshold.

excessive_exclamation_marks._comment: Fires when the total count of '!' in the article meets or exceeds the threshold.

excessive_question_marks._comment: Fires when the total count of '?' in the article meets or exceeds the threshold.

classification._comment: Thresholds are inclusive upper bounds. A score of exactly 30 is Credible; a score of exactly 60 is Suspicious.
